name: Walsrode (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Walsrode (a red church above a wavy bar and a wheel on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Walsrode; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Walsrode arms — church, wavy bar and wheel on yellow
